title: 15.19. Hetuduka, Atītārammaṇattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Hetuṁ atītārammaṇaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nahetu naatītārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …. Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
Hetuṁ anāgatārammaṇaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nahetu naanāgatārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …. Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
Hetuṁ paccuppannārammaṇaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nahetu napaccuppannārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …. Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
